posts.title: Was she there?
posts.description: No offense girl but why do you only love the men that hit you? No, not like that. On the platform, thinking about limits. Limits to feeling, to life, to power. posts.title: Burns as it goes down
posts.description: Rakuten Marketplace emails me repeatedly and with increasing intensity, like a scorned lover; the number of unopened messages multiplies as though by procreation, in an amount that borders on accusation. If the allegation is that I am too polite to unsubscribe, then guilty as charged. Spam, unremoved, piles in my mind in savory, wet, pink […]

posts.title: A promise of punishment
posts.description: 30,000 steps in an equatorial city, tears like baby diamonds behind my round sunglasses. I do all my best crying in faraway cities, as I walk among strangers.
